name: Light's Vigil

Light's Vigil
Level 60
1340 Mana20 - 40 yd range
1.5 sec cast6 sec cooldown
Requires Paladin
Requires level 60
Applies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes enemy targets to suffer 380 to 410 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost, or allied targets to heal their party for 700 to 740. You may only have one Light's Vigil active per party.
